details.jobDescription:
We are looking for a Senior System Engineer with a focus on Microsoft technologies interested in joining an ongoing project for one of our clients. You will be a member of our core engineering team, and will have an opportunity to advance in your career. Plan and implement new systems (Microsoft technologies) Maintain and constantly improve existing systems Determine bottleneck in the current systems and suggest solutions to problems Determine issues with business Internet connectivity, WAN technologies, remote access and VPN configuration Use diagnostic tools to determine deficiencies Suggest and oversee improvement processes Stay up to date with latest technology and best practices Attractive salary package Cool projects to work on
BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field
5 years of experience as a System Engineer or similar role
Very good understanding and knowledge of networking and application-level operations for Microsoft technologies
Ability to quickly diagnose issues and suggest solutions
Microsoft Certified Systems Engineer (MCSE) highly desirable
Experience with and knowledge of operating systems and server solutions (Exchange, SQL, Terminal Services (RDS), IIS, AD).·
Critical thinker and problem-solving skills
Team player
Good time-management skills
Great interpersonal and communication skills ︁︀​︂︀︀​︁︂︉​︇︉
